# Team 1 (Content, i18n & Proposals UI) batch — cold review

**Reviewer:** Claude Sonnet 5, orchestrating. Generated by `qwen3.8:27b` via the reforged
`run_team1_batch.py` (the three Team 2 fixes plus the two Team 3 fixes all baked in from the
start: no-echo rule, header required on both templates, running already-used-quotes list, an
explicit "only these real paths" list, and an explicit self-check against every sibling item's
title before finalizing), 8 tasks, ~14 minutes wall-clock (`_batch.log`). This review reads every
generated file directly against the real `ts5` source tree and live `ttod.yml`.
**Date:** 2026-09-11

## Verdict

**Promotable as generated — zero hand-fixes required.** The cleanest of the three batches run so
far. Both defect classes found in the Team 3 (Oracle) batch — wrong-module path citation and
sibling-scope leakage into another task's success criteria — did not recur once across all 8
sheets, despite this batch having a more tangled dependency graph between tasks (breadcrumbs vs.
empty-state vs. provenance, all touching the same three route files) than either prior batch.

## What was checked

1. **Path grounding** — every "Worked example" file-path claim checked against the real `ts5`
   tree. All 8 sheets cite only paths from the explicit "only these real paths" list supplied in
   the prompt (`pages/[locale]/wisdom/{index,[slug]}.astro`, `content/wisdom.ts`,
   `types/domain.ts`, `lib/auth.server.ts`) — zero drift onto a sibling module's path (graph,
   oracle, public, auth), the exact failure that hit 6 of 7 sheets in the Team 3 batch. Specific
   claims spot-checked and confirmed real: `frequencies(entries, field)`'s exact signature
   (task 6), `requireUser` at `auth.server.ts:62` (task 4), `WisdomEntry.rights`/`.origin`
   (task 5), `WisdomEntry.section`/`.level`/`.tags` (task 2).
2. **Sibling-scope discipline** — read all 5 full sheets (tasks 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) against every other
   item's title, not just adjacent ones. Task 4 (propose form) correctly stays out of Team 5's
   review-pipeline territory ("No Backend Changes... it only consumes the endpoint"). Task 6
   (tests) explicitly defers the propose form's *build* to Task 4, testing it rather than
   rebuilding it. Task 2 (breadcrumb) and Task 5 (provenance) both touch the same three route
   files without duplicating each other's rendering concern. No sheet restated another item's
   title as its own success criteria — the one defect Team 3's task 1 had despite an identical
   instruction being present there too.
3. **Quote citation integrity** — every cited id (`ux-002`, `img-009`, `arch-001`, `cc-009`,
   `qa-008`, `ux-004`, `cc-012`) checked by script against live `ttod.yml`: all real, all exact
   text matches (including `cc-012`'s nested dialogue, where the model correctly swapped the
   source's inner double-quotes for single-quotes to avoid colliding with the outer blockquote
   quoting — a formatting adaptation, not a textual alteration), all present in the 62-quote
   content pool supplied. Zero hallucinations.
4. **Quote repetition** — only one repeat in the whole batch: `arch-001` (tasks 4 and 8, five
   tasks apart, not adjacent). Both are genuinely about module-boundary respect (Task 4: staying
   inside the Content module's own boundary when consuming Team 5's endpoint; Task 8: reviewing
   another module strictly by its own brief). Left as-is — a lighter repeat density than either
   prior batch (Team 2: one triple; Team 3: three pairs).
5. **No-echo and header-line rules** — held on all 8 sheets, no exceptions. Zero duplicate closing
   blocks (Team 3's task 4 defect) — one "## Closing" per full sheet, one trailing quote per short
   sheet, matching the established short-sheet convention exactly.
6. **Orphan scope** — `team1_tasks.json`'s own upfront check against the real
   `wisdom/ASSIGNMENT.md`'s 6 Acceptance criteria found none (all 6 map cleanly onto some board
   item); nothing for this batch to have silently absorbed or needed to surface, unlike Team 2's
   orphaned "animation" or Team 3's three orphaned items.

## Numbering note (carried from `team1_tasks.json`, worth restating here for anyone reading only
## this review)

Board item 1 ("Build the localized wisdom index and detail routes") is the hello-world baseline,
already complete per `tasks.md`'s own "Starting point" note, with no acceptance criteria of its
own beyond the regression clause already folded into the existing `ASSIGNMENT-content-task1.md`
(which itself covers board item 2's content). This batch therefore covers board items 3–10 (8
items), filed as `task2` through `task9` to continue that file's own numbering — each sheet's
header says "Task: N of ~10" using the file number, not the board row number. Anyone adding a
`_tasks` Jekyll collection entry per row (§11 of `PHASE-U-FEII-TEACHING-SKELETON-CASCADE.md`)
should link by board row, not by this file-number scheme.
